 'scientific_question': 'Among CA1 pyramidal neurons that already have a severe reactive astrocyte cuff, does '
                        'requiring multiple nearby lymphocytes identify a denser inflammatory perineuronal niche that '
                        'predicts memory decline better than the current any-lymphocyte definition?',
 'approach': 'Compute a donor-level conditional immune-cuff fraction in CA1. Assign cells to CA1 from '
             'CustomAnnotations, identify CA1 Pyramidal Neurons as the target population, and for each target neuron '
             'count nearby Reactive Astrocytes and Lymphocytes within a 50 um centroid-to-centroid radius. Define a '
             'severe reactive cuff as at least 2 nearby Reactive Astrocytes. The biomarker is the fraction of '
             'severe-cuffed CA1 pyramidal neurons that also have at least k nearby Lymphocytes, where k is swept '
             'locally. Formula: score = (# CA1 pyramidal neurons with reactive_astrocytes>=2 and lymphocytes>=k within '
             '50 um) / (# CA1 pyramidal neurons with reactive_astrocytes>=2 within 50 um).',

                                'lymphocytes>=3 within 50 um.'}],
 'baseline_variation': 'candidate_variant_a',
 'notes': 'Keep the neighborhood construction identical to the prior r50um_ra2_ly1 conditional immune-cuff '
          'implementation, changing only the lymphocyte threshold. Annotation polygons are stored at 16x cell '
          'coordinates, so divide polygon coordinates by 16 before region assignment. Use slide-specific '
          'micron-to-pixel conversion if available from the paired SVS; otherwise keep the same radius handling as '
          'prior rounds for consistency. Handle low-denominator donors gracefully; if no CA1 pyramidal neurons meet '
          'the severe reactive-cuff denominator, return a defined fallback consistent with prior conditional-feature '
          'handling rather than failing.',
 'rationale': 'The accepted panel has converged on a CA1 peripyramidal reactive-cuff signal, and rounds 8-9 showed '
              'that adding lymphocyte admixture improves beyond astrocyte-only features. Both accepted immune features '
              'currently use a permissive lymphocyte threshold of at least 1 cell within 50 um, which may capture '
              'incidental immune contact. After the redundant reactive-burden-area attempt was discarded, the most '
              'informative next step is a small, biologically coherent threshold tightening within the same successful '
              'niche: test whether dense lymphocytic admixture is a cleaner inflammatory signal that can either add to '
              'or replace the current ly>=1 immune cuff feature.'}
